title: The last night of the first year
logline: The garage window from the alley on the last night of 2021: lit, a shape at the table, the pup's shape in the bed, Box 21 full and Box 22 begun. Rain. The hum line not under it.

panels.composition: The garage's casement window from the rainy alley at night, lit, the shape of a man at a table and a small dog in a bed, two cardboard boxes visible against the wall.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small lit garage window seen from a rainy alley at night with the shape of a man at a table and a small dog in a bed and two cardboard boxes against the wall, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
